rv.q: With four winningly charismatic leads and a deeply chilling script, Scarlett Dreams takes us on a roller coaster ride of ethical dilemmas in the brave new world of artificial intelligence.
While Scarlett Dreams is ultimately a cautionary tale with a shocking ending, the engaging acting and the impressive design elements makes this an entertaining show.
It's a main strength of 'Scarlett Dreams' how convincingly seductive the arguments the characters articulate on behalf of Artificial Intelligence.
The larger questions posed by this 2024 drama are courageous.
